calibration: t_calibrated = t / max(1, placebo_rms_t); p_calibrated two-sided normal; p_empirical = (1 + #|t_placebo| >= |t|) / (1 + #placebo); primary Holm on p_calibrated
family_rule: Holm within each (level, scope, target, kind) over all eligible tests; level in {pooled, per_stock}, scope in {all_days, news_days}, kind in {candidate, control}; a family spans both horizons (and all stocks for per_stock). Pooled magnitude also has a 'candidate_partial_vol' family (association net of the stock's own Volatility feature). Eligibility depends only on sample size and feature variation, never on outcomes.

placebo.type: circular shift of the target relative to the features, same offset for all stocks

statistic: Spearman rho = OLS slope of standardized ranks; Newey-West (per stock) / Driscoll-Kraay (pooled), Bartlett kernel, two-sided normal p

duplicates.sw_count_1: identical to event__article_count by construction (Phase 11B T13); both kept, each in its own feature family
